gloss: to be concerned with, to be involved

definitions.gloss: to be concerned with, to be involved
definitions.explanation: To have a connection or involvement with something.

examples.japanese: {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる{問題|もんだい}。
examples.english: A matter of life and death.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}く{関|かか}わっている。

notes:
{関|かか}わる is an intransitive verb meaning to be connected or involved with.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

PARTICLE USAGE:
- 〜に{関|かか}わる (to be involved with ~)
- 〜に{関|かか}わらず (regardless of ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仕事|しごと}に{関|かか}わる (be involved in work)
- {命|いのち}に{関|かか}わる (a matter of life and death)
- {深|ふか}く{関|かか}わる (be deeply involved)

RELATED VERBS:
- {関係|かんけい}する: to be related to
- {携|たずさ}わる: to be engaged in (more formal)
